description.value: A cross-sectional fMRI study tested whether reappraisal-related dorsal anterior cingulate activity was associated with preclinical atherosclerosis and whether IL-6 mediated that association in community volunteers.

spans.text: Here, we tested whether prefrontal engagement by reappraisal would be associated with atherosclerotic CVD risk and whether this association would be mediated by inflammatory activity.
